[[Garr the Merciful]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

== Missions ==

* [[Abbot's Robes]]
* [[Priest's Robes]]

== Notes ==
* Garr may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map. He shares them with [[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]], [[Cuthbert the Chaste]], [[Kenric the Believer]], [[Lars the Obeisant]], and [[Manton the Indulgent]]. As such, there is a chance that Garr will not spawn at all.
* Convert Hexes and Divine Intervention are skills that may be beneficial to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] from Garr in this [[mission]], since they can only be bought from [[skill trainer]]s in [[Camp Rankor]] and [[Copperhammer Mines]] respectively. Both [[outpost]]s are still a long way off in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]].
